name: Alice: A Hard Life
source:
you take on the role of Alice Garcia, a secret agent working for the government. She lives in a small, quiet apartment building. Having been involved in many missions so far, Alice has a maverick personality. That's why she hasn't been able to fulfill the missions she's been given. She is given one last chance and is given a new mission.

Alice takes a job at a private high school as a teacher in the seniors class. In this new and challenging job, she will meet many people, face many challenges and will have to compromise her own lifestyle and personality.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/caylake/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演爱丽丝·加西亚（Alice Garcia）的角色，她是一名为政府工作的特工。她住在一栋安静的小公寓楼里。迄今为止，爱丽丝参与了许多任务，性格特立独行。这就是为什么她无法完成赋予她的使命。她得到了最后一次机会，并被赋予了新的使命。

爱丽丝在一所私立高中找到了一份高年级老师的工作。在这份新的、充满挑战的工作中，她会遇到很多人，面临很多挑战，并且不得不妥协自己的生活方式和个性。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/caylake/about]Patreon[/url]]
